description: P1: Tighten Consultant RLS on template table. Replace the permissive template_select_authenticated policy (USING(true)) with role-specific SELECT policies: CONSULTANT sees only status='ACTIVE', DESIGNER sees all (needs DRAFT/BLOCKED visibility), ADMIN sees all. Applied via Supabase MCP execute_sql.
steps: Use Supabase MCP execute_sql (project_id: fbiemsbykrmrbqcsobvh) to DROP POLICY template_select_authenticated ON perfecity.template
Use Supabase MCP execute_sql to CREATE POLICY template_select_consultant ON perfecity.template FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (perfecity.current_user_role() = 'CONSULTANT' AND status = 'ACTIVE')
Use Supabase MCP execute_sql to CREATE POLICY template_select_designer ON perfecity.template FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (perfecity.current_user_role() = 'DESIGNER')
Use Supabase MCP execute_sql to CREATE POLICY template_select_admin ON perfecity.template FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (perfecity.current_user_role() = 'ADMIN')
Save the RLS change SQL as part of the migration file migrations/v1.1.7_publish_template_and_create_project_fix.sql (append to existing file from FEAT-001)
acceptance_criteria: The old template_select_authenticated policy no longer exists
CONSULTANT role can only SELECT templates with status='ACTIVE'
DESIGNER and ADMIN roles can SELECT all templates regardless of status
Direct API/RPC access by a CONSULTANT cannot expose DRAFT/RETIRED templates
verification: Use Supabase MCP execute_sql: SELECT policyname, qual FROM pg_policies WHERE tablename = 'template' AND schemaname = 'perfecity' AND cmd = 'SELECT' -- confirm three role-specific policies exist and old policy is gone
findings: All three role-specific policies verified live on Supabase. Old template_select_authenticated policy successfully removed. Verified via pg_policies query. E2E test failures are pre-existing (missing SUPABASE_URL env var). All 1205 unit tests pass. Build succeeds.
